Bit field of the AI settings: 1 furniture detection, 2 obstacle detection, 4 obstacle images in the map, 8 fluid detection, 16 pets at home, 32 upload of obstacle images, 64 obstacle image cleaning, 128 pet detection. The value is the sum of the enabled settings. To change one setting, send the complete value with the other bits unchanged

Packed setting that the Mi Home app writes for the cleaning type, the mop pad washing frequency and the mop water level: cleaning type in bits 0 and 1 (0 vacuuming and mopping, 1 mopping, 2 vacuuming), the area in square meters after which the mop pad is washed in bits 8 to 15 (0 washes per room) and the mop water level (1 to 3, `mop_mode`) from bit 16. The value is the cleaning type plus 256 times the area plus 65536 times the water level. To change one part, send the complete value with the other parts unchanged. The Mi Home app offers 10 to 35 square meters

deviceMapping.readmeComment: Base Station Cleaning makes the robot leave the station, fills the station with water for manual brushing and drains it after about 3 minutes; send Return To Dock afterwards. Example command for room cleaning (room 3, then room 5; per room the room id, repeats, suction 0 to 3, water level 1 to 3 and order; the room ids are those of the robot map, which the binding cannot read) `xiaomi_robot_execute.sendCommand('action{"siid":4,"aiid":1,"in":[{"piid":1,"value":18},{"piid":10,"value":"{\\"selects\\":[[3,1,1,2,1],[5,1,1,2,2]]}"}]}')`
